abstract.t: This document addresses the noisy neighbour problem without requiring a stable client identifier at the origin. Separately allocated budgets let origins limit consumption beneath a shared platform identity. It describes PACE: a framework for managing budget continuity across requests using a composition of the Web Bot Auth with the Moderation of unLinkable Endorsements (MOLE) architecture [MOLE-ARCH] and protocols [MOLE-PROTOCOLS]. This composition allows for per-client capacity management in a way that allows origins to serve clients above an otherwise constrained public baseline.
